title: Project Manager
jobDescription:
Do you want to be part of a team who shapes the future of power managements with products and solutions using Ga N devices that make systems more efficient and smarter?

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Be responsible for Project Management for integrated Ga N products / System Projects.
  • Manage the activities to develop the required silicon drivers or controllers dies and the Ga N HEMTs and combine these in one package.
  • Coordinate and lead projects from requirements gathering through chip design, characterization, and qualification, all the way to volume ramp-up.
  • Lead cross-functional and multicultural project teams from various locations, creating the energy and passion to reach ambitious project targets
  • Take full project management responsibility for all project targets and plans (milestones, resources, risks, budget, costs)
  • Facilitate timely project decision-making, ensure consistent progress, and lead through challenges while serving as a role model for the team.
  • Handle the project in a fast and market-driven environment with a clear focus on the business objectives, support customer interactions as needed
  • Own the project results, deliverables and success.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process to be leaner and thus faster.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Passion to shape Ga N development and -projects to drive them to success in a highly competitive environment.
  • 5 years of experience in leading end to end semiconductor development projects with relevant functional experience.
  • Must have driven projects from product definition to qualification and volume production
  • Should have reasonable understanding of business case development processes and semiconductor product development budget.
  • Should have worked with or lead project teams that include functional leads for product definition, design, design verification, test and characterization, application and marketing, quality and reliability and manufacturing including wafer fabrication and packaging.
  • Demonstrated Project Management skills (IPMA-C certification is a plus).
  • Experience of leading cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel internationally from time to time, mainly to our locations in Europe and Asia.
  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Power Electronics, or comparable.
  • Excellent English language and presentation skills.

title: Senior Staff Specialist IT - Windchill
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Java Windchill Developer specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to design, develop, and maintain customizations, integrations utilizing Windchill. The Java developer will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and QA, to deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Windchill applications, integrations, and plugins using Java, to meet business requirements and improve product lifecycle management.
  • Develop custom APIs using Windchill's Java-based API, to integrate with other systems, services, or applications, ensuring seamless data exchange and functionality.
  • Implement business logic, workflows, and rules using Windchill's Java-based scripting engine, to automate and streamline product development, manufacturing, and quality processes.
  • Ensure high-quality code, following best practices, coding standards, and Windchill's development guidelines, to maintain scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, project managers, and other developers, to ensure successful project delivery and effective communication.
  • Stay current with Windchill's latest releases, features, and best practices, applying this knowledge to improve custom applications, integrations, and plugins.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • At least 6+ years of experience in Java development for Windchill.
  • Proficiency in Java, including Java 8 or later, with experience in Java-based development, debugging, and troubleshooting.
  • In-depth knowledge of Windchill's architecture, APIs, and development tools
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Familiarity with Dev Ops practices and tools, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Windchill Certifications is added advantage.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban.

title: Application Support Consultant
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Application Support Consultant specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to perform Configurations at UI level, Bulk Data Corrections, Data Validation in Windchill Production system. Will be responsible for smooth operations of PLM functionalities and features supporting the end users and Customers. The Application Support Consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams, Service Owners/application owners, Business Owners, to maintain robust PLM functionalities and workflow serving the end users.

Job Description

In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Utilities to enable Windchill applications, workflows, and integrations to meet business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Develop and maintain SQL scripts.
  • Develop reports using QML.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Windchill-related issues, including performance with data integrity, and security in mind.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Application Support activities.
  • Work on Incident Management, Service Request Fulfilment as in a L2 role.
  • Collaborate with L3 functional and L3 technical teams to resolve problems.
  • Work with external Business partners and guide the team whenever necessary.
  • Resolve Major tickets within the defined SLA.
  • Get the Handover from Project.
  • Documentation of SOP procedures and ensure Operational Excellence.
  • Work with deployment team to deploy the developed scripts during the Project release.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 3+ years of experience in Windchill development or Windchill Maintenance or Windchill Migration with a strong understanding of Windchill Architecture, Windchill Business Administration and knowledge in Windchill Database structures.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries and Oracle procedures.
  • Strong understanding of PLM concepts, data modelling, and data governance.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Willing to work in shift. Especially support European time zone.
  • Process oriented mindset. Able to Optimise and Automate using latest technologies.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (scrum or kanban) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Added advantage if you are ITIL certified

title: Senior Staff Engineer Verification
jobDescription:
In depth understanding of ASIC verification concepts and techniques . Ability to architect complex module / sub system / full chip testbenches and build verification infrastructure in SV/UVM.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new ROLE:
  • Verification of complex So Cs / IPs and provide technical leadership to the team while creating test plans and Verification Infrastructure
  • Adopt state of art Verification methods. Develop expertise in multiple areas of verification – Formal/Gate level/Power aware Verification
  • Drive Verification closure of complex IPs and So Cs using SV/UVM based methodology
  • Developing C models for DSP and Verification
  • Schedule management and handling cross functional team interactions
  • Mentoring and guiding the team to keep Verification execution on track.


Your Profile

    • EDUCATION: B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech

    • In depth understanding of ASIC verification concepts and techniques. Ability to architect complex module / sub system / full chip testbenches and build verification infrastructure in SV/UVM.

title: Specialist SCM
jobDescription:
We are seeking highly motivated and analytical individuals to join our Supply Chain Planning team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced, global environment where you will help drive supply chain excellence through data-driven decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and process optimization. As a Supply Chain Planning Analyst, you will play a critical role in aligning customer requirements with operational capabilities, ensuring efficient planning and execution across the supply chain

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Understand customer product requirements and ensure supply chain plans are aligned to meet business and customer expectations.
  • Analyze supply chain data, business trends, and operational challenges to identify root causes and recommend effective solutions.
  • Support demand, supply, inventory, and production planning activities through data-driven insights.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Sales to drive business objectives.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and contribute to overall business performance.
  • Implement and support supply chain processes, tools, and systems that enable scalable growth and operational excellence.
  • Work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced, and global environment with shared responsibilities across multiple geographies.
  • Generate reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support planning and decision-making processes.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Required

    • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, or a related Science discipline.
    • 0–1 year of experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, Analytics, or related domains.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and macros.
    • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to work effectively across organizational boundaries, functions, and cultures.
    • Comfortable working in ambiguous situations and adapting to changing business priorities.

    Preferred

    • Exposure to enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems such as SAP or Oracle.
    • Familiarity with supply chain planning platforms such as JDA, Blue Yonder, or i2 Technologies.
    • Basic knowledge of PL/SQL or database querying concepts.
    • Academic or project exposure to Statistics, Operations Research, forecasting, optimization, or supply chain analytics.
    • Internship experience in Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, Planning, or Operations.

title: Director Digital Design
jobDescription:
Drive Digital mixed Signal Verification of Complex Signal processing IPs and chips

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role
  • Drive Digital mixed Signal Verification of Complex Signal processing IPs and chips
  • Enable AI in Verification
  • Technical guidance and career mentorship to the team
  • Lead from the front
  • Hands-on experience building Simulink models that correlate to fixed-point hardware implementations (bit-accurate or tolerance-defined reference models).
  • Experience collaborating with RTL design and DV teams (UVM/scoreboards/reference models), driving requirements-to-implementation traceability.
  • Ability to interpret and integrate analog collateral (ADC behaviour, trims/calibration, validity timing, comparators/monitors) into digital models and verification plans.
  • Strong system-thinking and ownership mindset; comfortable leading cross-team technical decisions and driving signoff-quality closure.
  • Power converter control experience (multi-phase regulation, current sharing, transient optimization) is highly desired
  • Mixed-signal verification exposure (co-simulation workflows, model correlation).


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • System modelling & specification: Build end-to-end behavioural models (plant + sensing + digital control + telemetry), define measurable requirements (stability, transient response, accuracy, latency), and translate them into implementable specs.
  • Filter/algorithm implementation alignment: Own the modelling and fixed-point specification of key digital signal-processing elements (moving averages, programmable IIR poles/compensators, notch/CIC-style filters, envelope/marker capture, scaling/formatting), and work with RTL designers to ensure faithful implementation.
  • Strong background in discrete-time filter design and fixed-point DSP implementation (IIR/PID, rounding/saturation behaviour, coefficient quantization, numeric stability).
  • Cross-functional integration: Act as the technical interface between analog and digital teams; Define analog collateral (ADC behaviour, sampling/validity timing, trims/calibration, comparators/monitors) and ensure consistent assumptions in models, RTL, and verification.
  • Verification strategy & closure: Define multi-level verification strategy (math-block golden models → subsystem digital verification →mixed-signal validation → full-chip end-to-end scenarios) and drive closure with verification leads.
  • Bring-up & debug readiness: Define bring-up checklists, debug observability requirements, and lab validation plans; support root-cause analysis across RTL, firmware, and bench data.
  • Documentation & leadership: Own technical collateral (architecture, modelling assumptions, coefficient derivations, fixed-point formats, test plans) and lead design/verification reviews.

Vidhi Ashok.Thakkar@infineon.com

title: Principal Engineer Digital Design
jobDescription:
The Multi Phase controller IP Lead is responsible for end-to-end definition, execution, and delivery of a control- and filter-centric signal processing digital IP that interfaces with high complexity AFEs. This role drives architecture closure across algorithm intent, fixed-point implementation, RTL micro-architecture, register/bus interfaces, verification strategy, and implementation readiness. The IP Lead aligns System modelling, Analog, RTL, DV, and DMS/AMS teams to ensure the IP meets functional, performance, latency, quality, and integration goals.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

Technical Ownership

  • Own end-to-end IP definition from requirements through architecture, implementation, verification, and handoff.
  • Translate system and product requirements into a clear IP micro-architecture and execution plan.
  • Drive closure on algorithm intent, control behavior, filter architecture, latency budgets, and implementation trade-offs.
  • Review and converge control/filter algorithm definition, sampling intent, and expected behavior with signal-processing architects.
  • Drive fixed-point architecture decisions including numeric precision, dynamic range, saturation, rounding, scaling, and pipeline placement.
  • Oversee RTL architecture for filter data path, coefficient programming, update paths, loop delays, state machines, and control logic.
  • Own top-level design decisions affecting timing, CDC, reset strategy, area, power, and implementation robustness.
  • Guide register architecture, status/control visibility, firmware programmability, and system integration behavior.
  • Drive architecture and RTL for AHB/PM Bus/AVS or other system-facing interfaces, including arbitration and error handling.
  • Define verification goals and signoff expectations jointly with DV and AMS verification leads.
  • Ensure availability of golden models, bit-true checking strategy, coverage goals, and end-to-end latency checks.
  • Drive closure on corner cases including overflow, convergence, saturation recovery, limit cycles, reset behavior, and protocol exceptions.
  • Ensure analog assumptions, abstraction boundaries, and mixed-signal interaction points are verified appropriately.
  • Review and close functional gaps across RTL, DV, DMS/AMS, and system validation.
  • Break down execution into work packages, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation plans.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering,
  • Strong experience leading digital or mixed-signal-adjacent IP development.
  • Strong understanding of control loops, DSP/filter implementations, or fixed-point digital signal processing.

jobDescription:
We are Looking for a professional to drive website governance by standardizing content structures, eliminating duplication, and ensuring consistent placement across platforms. The role involves training stakeholders, aligning with PIM processes, implementing governance frameworks, and tracking compliance to improve content quality and efficiency globally

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Create and maintain detailed website governance rules, including all types of content (e.g., images, documents, trainings, videos, parameters, etc.) and their placement on the website.
  • Eliminate redundant practices, like inconsistent content placement or duplications (e.g., the same document uploaded multiple times with different hierarchies).
  • Standardize structural and technical details for similar product categories to achieve clarity and alignment across divisions.
  • Train divisions and stakeholders on the rules, guidelines, and governance framework, making sure they are understood and adopted globally.
  • Set up a governance framework with clear processes to communicate new rules and guidelines and ensure they are implemented effectively across the organization.
  • Work with the PIM Team to align content management processes with central governance and web publishing standards, creating a seamless end-to-end flow for content implementation.
  • Develop a process to track compliance with governance guidelines and provide feedback loops to improve adoption and execution.



Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience as Web Content Manager or similar role, ideally at a large, decentralized organization transitioning toward centralized governance and frameworks.
  • Expertise in creating and implementing web content governance frameworks, rules, and guidelines.
  • A track record of developing scalable processes and establishing buy-in across diverse teams with differing priorities.
  • Strong understanding of web user journeys, conversion best practices, and content placement to support business growth objectives such as lead generation and organic traffic.
  • Experience working with PIM systems, web publishing workflows, and collaborating with technical teams (e.g., UX, IT, and Web Teams) to implement functionalities.
  • Familiarity with SEO-driven web content management and understanding of the relationship between content structure, hierarchy, and traffic performance.
  • Outstanding communication and collaboration skills to foster support and accountability across divisional teams and stakeholders.
